تعرنكسين (form IIIq)
# تَعْرَنْكِسِينَ (taʕrankisīna) /taʕ.ran.ki.siː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِعْرَنْكَسَ (iʕrankasa)
# تُعْرَنْكَسِينَ (tuʕrankasīna) /tuʕ.ran.ka.siː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْرَنْكَسَ (iʕrankasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
